authority.userRequest: Primordial means an entity at the beginning that was not created by another god. Deliberate self-creation is not required. Retain old-legends preference and current-Indonesian-religion exclusion.
authority.scope: User assigns race6/Champion3 and delegates lore recipes; canonical working roster and design integration now recorded. Runtime/body profiles remain configuration.
authority.authored: Candidate selection, classifications and possible game themes are assistant curation; myth facts are source-qualified.

label: Primordial (Makhluk Pertama)
concept: Entitas awal penciptaan yang tidak diciptakan atau diperanakkan oleh dewa lain dalam versi legenda yang dipilih. Tidak wajib sengaja menciptakan diri sendiri.
superseded: The Kosmos/Alam/Kehidupan selector and proposed Durability+1/Intelligence+1 recipe are retired suggestions. Their replacement recipes are assigned in content/primordial-events-design.json under the user six/three-point instruction.

curationConstraints.scope: Only this optional proposal; keep all already accepted races unchanged.
curationConstraints.religionContext: Ancient origin does not prove a tradition has no present-day followers; this is audience-focused curation.

suggestedIdentityWheel.label: Tokoh Primordial
suggestedIdentityWheel.selectionMode: Eleven working identities under the confirmed origin definition, now assigned six-point race and three-point Champion recipes through delegated lore curation. The roster remains editable; use the canonical primordial-identity selector rather than this former proposal mirror.
suggestedIdentityWheel.probability: Canonical primordial-identity has eleven equal base weights1.

outcomes.label: Atum
outcomes.context: Menciptakan dirinya sendiri di air purba Nun, lalu memulai penciptaan para dewa.
outcomes.sourceVersion: Heliopolitan creation account, rooted in the Pyramid Texts.

outcomes.label: Khepri
outcomes.context: Dewa self-created, dilambangkan scarab dan matahari terbit; terkait kemunculan dan pembaruan.
outcomes.sourceVersion: McClung Museum account of the sacred scarab.

outcomes.label: Amun
outcomes.context: Dalam himne Leiden, pencipta yang tersembunyi ini membentuk dan menciptakan dirinya sendiri.
outcomes.sourceVersion: Papyrus Leiden I 350, chapter 40; composite creator identities in this hymnal tradition.

outcomes.label: Neith
outcomes.context: Dewi pencipta awal; Esna 204 menggambarkannya hadir sendiri sebelum menciptakan yang lain. Perbedaan terjemahan self-origin tetap metadata, tidak lagi menjadi syarat wajib.
outcomes.sourceVersion: Esna 204 initial sole creator; Esna 206 section 2 and footnote 37 preserve the self-origin translation caveat.

eligibilityAssessment.basis: pass-in-Esna-204-first-sole-creator-account; self-origin translation caveat retained as lore

outcomes.label: Ptah
outcomes.context: Pencipta utama dalam kosmogoni Memphis, membentuk dunia lewat pikiran dan ucapan; dipilih menurut versi Memphite.
outcomes.sourceVersion: Memphite Theology on the Shabaka Stone.

eligibilityAssessment.basis: pass-as-Memphite-primary-creator; authored curation inference from reviewed account

outcomes.label: Chaos / Khaos
outcomes.context: Yang pertama muncul dalam Theogony; asal sebelumnya tidak dijelaskan, bukan self-creation eksplisit.
outcomes.interpretationGuard: Primordial chasm/gap, not automatically a god of randomness or destruction.

outcomes.label: Gaia
outcomes.context: Bumi purba muncul pada awal kisah, lalu melahirkan langit tanpa pasangan. Teks tidak menyebut Gaia sebagai anak Chaos.

outcomes.label: Namma / Nammu
outcomes.context: Ibu purba langit dan bumi, terkait air kosmik. Riwayatnya terbatas; penciptaan dirinya sendiri tidak diklaim.
outcomes.sourceVersion: An-Anum I 28 and Enki and Ninmah, discussed by Nicole Brisch.

outcomes.label: Apsu / Abzu
outcomes.context: Air tawar purba yang bercampur dengan Tiamat untuk melahirkan para dewa; bukan self-creation eksplisit.
outcomes.sourceVersion: Opening of Enuma Elish, discussed by Sophus Helle.

outcomes.label: Tiamat
outcomes.context: Laut asin purba dan ibu para dewa; kelak membentuk pasukan monster. Asal dirinya tidak dinyatakan self-created.
outcomes.sourceVersion: Enuma Elish, discussed by Sophus Helle.
outcomes.interpretationGuard: Use the ancient figure, not an automatic substitution of the modern D&D five-headed dragon.

outcomes.label: Ymir
outcomes.context: Raksasa purba terbentuk ketika panas mencairkan es; tubuhnya kemudian menjadi bahan dunia. Bukan dewa dalam arti sempit teks ini.
outcomes.sourceVersion: Gylfaginning 5–8; medieval written witness to older traditions.
outcomes.interpretationGuard: Fits primordial entity scope as a first living giant formed from elements, without claiming he is a god or deliberately self-created.

gameAdaptationBoundary: Themes are inspiration only: no automatic Tier 5, Creation Power, maximum mastery, Authority, stat bonus or extra spin follows from a myth label.
overlapDecision: Atum/Khepri share Egyptian solar-creation associations. The working eleven-identity selector retains both as distinct variants; future roster edits can revisit this overlap.
archetypeProposal: Primordial six-point package skips initial Archetype; Champion three-point patron applies to otherwise eligible compatible characters.
notIntegrated: Owned race and Champion reward execution adapter
nextDecision: Review/edit exact authored recipes and configure intrinsic power/weapon/body/Size/Champion-fit profiles; next untouched Archetype remains Champion’s Legacy.

definitionContract.userClarification: as long as they are not created by other god and the first. they count as primordial
conditions: At the origin of the selected cosmogony
Not created, engendered or born from another deity in that selected account
definitionContract.firstInterpretation: Design interpretation: a first entity, co-first pair, or initial independently emerging generation before derivative divine genealogies; not every later creator or merely old god. The earliest cosmic medium may pre-exist without acting as a deity-parent.
definitionContract.indirectCreationRule: A deity that deliberately fashions the egg or vessel of another entity counts as a creator; intermediate egg birth does not bypass the rule.
definitionContract.versionRule: Evaluate one stated source version; do not combine incompatible genealogies into one eligibility claim.
definitionContract.uncertaintyRule: An unknown origin remains review-needed until a source-qualified design assessment exists; absence of a named parent is not a claim that every tradition denies parents.
definitionContract.logicalPredicate: originPosition in {first, co-first, initial-independent-generation} AND noOtherDeityCreatorAssessment=pass; false excludes, unknown requires review. Runtime registration remains disabled.
definitionContract.mechanicsScope: This is a curation contract for a draft identity list; it dispatches no event or reward.

excludedCandidates.label: Phanes
excludedCandidates.context: Pencipta awal yang menetas dari telur kosmik, terkait lahirnya kehidupan. Kisah telur itu berbeda menurut versi Orphic.
excludedCandidates.sourceVersion: Attributed Orphic passages, including Rhapsodies fragment 66.

eligibilityAssessment.reason: Orphic Rhapsodies fragment 66 has Chronos fashion the egg from which Phanes is born; fragment 54 also places other principles before him.

excludedCandidates.interpretationGuard: Mythological label primordial or first-born does not override the user's no-other-deity-creator criterion.

approval.implementationBoundary: Approval of algorithm design; runtime executors, body/Size/capability profiles remain configuration. Other technical projection choices retain their disclosed authored provenance.
